entries.item: Earthly Grains Parmesan Couscous 5.9 OZ
entries.reason: Couscous, not grated/shredded parmesan cheese - the word 'Parmesan' is a flavour descriptor on a boxed grain side dish.

entries.item: Cheez-It DUOZ Sharp Cheddar and Parmesan Cheese Crackers
entries.reason: Cheese CRACKERS, not parmesan cheese.

entries.item: Ibp Ribeye Beef Steak Burgers 1.33 Lb
entries.reason: 'Steak Burgers' are formed ground-beef patties, not a ribeye steak.

entries.item: Fremont Fish Market Jumbo Butterfly Shrimp 9 OZ
entries.reason: Breaded butterfly shrimp (a prepared/battered product); the commodity is frozen RAW shrimp, so this is not comparable.

entries.item: Simply Nature Organic Basil Stir IN Paste 2.8 OZ
entries.reason: Basil stir-in PASTE in a tube, not fresh basil leaves.

entries.item: Lunch Buddies Mixed Fruit IN Black Cherry Gel Bowls 4 3 OZ
entries.reason: Mixed-fruit gel snack cups, not fresh cherries.

entries.item: Burman S Spicy Brown Mustard 12 OZ
entries.reason: Spicy brown mustard is a different mustard style from Dijon; Aldi's own Dijon is a separate SKU.

entries.item: Dill Relish
entries.reason: DILL relish; the commodity is Sweet Relish, which is a different product at a different price point.

entries.item: Chophouse Cajun Seasoning with Jalapeno
entries.reason: A jalapeno-flavoured variant, and the number is not credible: 12 oz at $0.0833/oz = $1.00 for a 12 oz shaker against $4.58 for the 16 oz runner-up. Almost certainly a bad price/size parse - drop rather than publish a 71%-below-runner-up crown.

entries.item: Thomas' bagels, protein bagels or muffin tops, 6 ct., $3.99
entries.reason: Combined multi-product ad line (bagels OR protein bagels OR muffin tops) - no single product to price.

entries.item: Easy-Off, Lime-A-Way or Old English cleaner, 14.5 to 32 oz., $3.99
entries.reason: Combined multi-product ad line across three brands AND a 14.5-32 oz size range - the per-ounce price is undefined.

entries.item: Guerrero fajita 20 ct. or burrito tortillas 8 ct., $2.49
entries.reason: Combined ad line offering two different counts (20 ct OR 8 ct) at one price - the per-tortilla price depends on which you buy.

entries.item: Organic Red Beets
entries.reason: Is the commodity, but organic - not like-for-like against conventional beets.

entries.item: Maxwell House Decaffeinated Original Medium Roast Ground Coffee, 29.3 oz Canister
entries.reason: Is ground coffee, but decaffeinated rather than the plain regular grind.

entries.item: Member's Mark Chocolate Croissants, 12 ct.
entries.reason: Is a croissant, but chocolate-filled rather than plain.

entries.item: Mini Avocados Bag 6 CT
entries.reason: Is avocados, but the mini size - a per-each price is not like-for-like against standard Hass.

entries.item: Organic Girl Organic Baby Arugula
entries.reason: Is the commodity, but organic.

entries.item: Lee Kum Kee Chili Crisp Hot Honey Sauce
entries.reason: Is chili crisp, but the hot-honey flavour variant rather than the plain chiu chow style.

entries.item: Kroger Fat Free Small Curd Cottage Cheese
entries.reason: Is cottage cheese, but the fat-free version rather than the standard 4% milkfat.

entries.item: Murphy Oil Soap Wood Cleaner Original
entries.reason: Adjacent product - a wood cleaning soap rather than a furniture polish; kept because it is the same shelf category, but it is not like-for-like.

entries.item: Joseph's Flax Oat Bran & Whole Wheat Pita Bread
entries.reason: Is pita, but a flax/oat-bran whole-wheat specialty loaf rather than plain white pita.

entries.item: Kroger Caramel Rice Cakes
entries.reason: Is rice cakes, but caramel-flavoured rather than plain/lightly salted.

entries.item: Fresh Usda Choice Whole Sirloin Tip
entries.annotation: whole sirloin tip (roast cut), not a cut steak
entries.reason: Same primal and genuinely comparable per pound, but sold as a whole sirloin tip rather than cut steaks.

entries.item: Green Giant Season Brussel Sprout Intro
entries.annotation: seasoned prepared pack, and the 13.551 oz size is derived rather than stated
entries.reason: Is brussels sprouts, but a seasoned Green Giant pack rather than plain sprouts, and its size was backed out of the unit price. Kept because the number is credible - only 2% under the Fareway runner-up, so the crown barely moves.

entries.item: Priano Gnocchi 176 OZ
entries.annotation: name misstates the size - the pack is 17.6 oz, and the price is computed off the correct 17.6 oz
entries.reason: Price and unit price are right (17.6 oz at $1.89). Only the displayed NAME carries the Aldi URL-slug decimal artifact (17.6 -> 176), so this is a cosmetic name defect, not a pricing error.
